Mind Shift: Episode 3

Join Ashley Schroeder, Senior UX Designer at Southwest Airlines, Brian Crumley, Senior Engineer at O3 World, and Whitney Quesenbery, Co-Founder at the Center for Civic Design for the next session of the MindShift webinar series hosted by O3 World.

On February 23, 2021 at 4 p.m. ET we’ll uncover how to introduce, evangelize and gain buy-in for accessibility within enterprise organizations.
